text: Carpenter's work involves using hand tools to make furniture and structures. Varnish is a top coat that can protect the wood surface from moisture, and joints are made to join different parts of a piece of wood together. Carpenter's work requires precision and attention to detail, so they must be able to accurately measure and cut the wood. They must also be able to shape the wood using tools like saws and planes, and they must be able to perform tasks like drilling holes and threading nails. Carpenter's work is important for building homes, furniture, and other structures. They must be able to work safely and with precision, and they must be able to perform tasks under tight deadlines.
